asc_inceleme_notu_en: Version 1.73 adds an optional tip jar (Profile > Support us) with three consumable in-app purchases: com.nickdegs.kisisel.destek.kucuk, .orta and .buyuk. Tips unlock no features or content; the entire app remains free. Sign in with Apple to test; the Support us row is at the bottom of the Profile tab.
